goals.name: BH
goals.criteria: Polished happy heel and overall routine. Attentive, tail up and ears and floating. Dog loves the work but is precise in all the exercises.

exercises.name: Heeling
exercises.finishedPicture: Happy floating gate with ears and tail up. Precision - looking at me but not wrapped head and body parallel. Dogs shoulder even with my left leg. Floating gate with no stiffness.
exercises.criteria: Both emotion and precision are there and dog loves heeling.

components.name: Emotion
components.finishedPicture: Happy floating gate with ears and tail up. Floating gate with no stiffness.

steps.name: Step 1 - Party Heeling
steps.description: Classically condition the heel so Java loves heeling and it shows in her body during the exercise.
steps.criterion: Java is open, active, loose and engaged while heeling happens inside running, chasing, possession play and goofy handler interaction. No precision criterion.
steps.rule: Recommend ADVANCE after 2 sessions rated Full/Solid or Beautiful where the desired emotional state is present from the beginning and Kerrie does not have to repeatedly manufacture/recover it. Productive = repeat. Rough/Spilled = repeat/reassess rather than advance.Classically condition the heel

steps.name: Step 2 - Happy Movement Changes
steps.description: Java can stay loose and happy when I start adding small bits of slower movements.
steps.criterion: Java keeps the same open, active emotional state through changes in movement: running, walking, faster/slower movement and direction changes. Changes in handler speed do not automatically collapse the picture.
steps.rule: Recommend ADVANCE after 2 Full/Beautiful sessions where Java maintains the emotional picture through multiple movement changes, including at least some slower walking, without a consistent emotional drop. An occasional dip that immediately recovers can still be successful. Repeated drop at the same transition = REPEAT.

steps.name: Step 3 - Playful Heeling Picture
steps.description: Slightly more bits of more normal walking. No trial picture yet.
steps.criterion: Short recognizable pieces of heeling occur inside the game. Kerrie can walk more normally while still interacting/playful, and Java remains active and expressive rather than switching into the old compressed formal picture.
steps.rule: Recommend ADVANCE after 2 Full/Beautiful sessions where several short recognizable heeling pieces occur without the old formal/compressed picture becoming the dominant response. If Java repeatedly needs barking/running to reopen after every tiny heel exposure, REPEAT.

steps.name: Step 4 - Normal Handler Picture — Micro Doses
steps.description: Tiny bit of normal trial picture added in - shoulders back, walking straight and not turning head towards Java. Can look at Java without turning head.
steps.criterion: Kerrie briefly adopts increasingly normal trial posture, stride and orientation. Java stays emotionally open during those brief exposures. Play can resume before quality declines.
steps.rule: Recommend ADVANCE after 2 Full/Beautiful sessions where Java maintains the desired emotional state through several brief normal-handler-picture exposures without requiring an immediate rescue every time. steps.name: Step 5 -   Variable Normal Heeling
steps.description: Longer amounts of trial picture heeling and less intense and frequent playing around. Mixing in barking looking at the dog and talking to her and crazy fooling chase games but less chase games when in the heel portion.
steps.criterion: Java maintains the desired emotional picture through unpredictable amounts of normal/trial-picture heeling. Step counts and reward timing vary. Precision is still a separate component.
steps.rule: Recommend ADVANCE after 3 Full/Beautiful sessions across variable normal-heeling durations, with no consistent relationship between “more steps” and emotional collapse and no obvious dependence on a predictable reward point. At least one session should include a longer-than-usual stretch that remains emotionally good. Productive sessions with useful recoveries = stay here.

steps.name: Step 6 - Normal Heeling Is Part of the Game
steps.description: Way more trial picture but still adding in some of the barking, talking, looking at and fooling around but way more formal trial picture.
steps.criterion: Transitions between play, barking, interaction and ordinary trial-style heeling become emotionally seamless. “Formal heel starts now” no longer reliably produces a different Java.
steps.rule: Recommend ADVANCE after 3 Full/Beautiful sessions where Java repeatedly moves play → normal heel → interaction/play → normal heel without a consistent emotional change at the transitions. If she is great in play but predictably changes when normal heeling begins, REPEAT.

steps.name: Step 7 - Sustained Trial Picture
steps.description: Mostly trial picture with way less trying to get Java to go into the emotional state as the state is starting to be conditioned to the heel.
steps.criterion: Java can remain open, active and expressive through substantially longer stretches of normal heeling without exaggerated handler animation being necessary to maintain the state.
steps.rule: Recommend ADVANCE after 3 Full/Beautiful sessions showing sustained emotional quality at varied durations, including longer stretches, without Kerrie needing to repeatedly reopen Java with exaggerated movement. At least 2 sessions should occur on different days; preferably not identical setups.

steps.name: Step 8 - Emotion Under BH Structure
steps.description: Java can sustain the emotional picture through an entire BH routine.
steps.criterion: Java maintains the desired emotional state while actual BH heeling structure is layered in: longer sequences, pace changes, turns and other already-trained elements. Structure does not turn heeling back into the old emotional picture.
steps.rule: MAINTENANCE / GENERALIZATION rather than automatic advancement. Consider this component established when Java produces Full/Beautiful emotional sessions repeatedly across BH-like sequences, different days and relevant environments without the old compressed picture becoming the default. Continue maintaining it while Precision, Duration, Turns, etc. develop separately.
